title: Artemis II

description:
Episode 39 of a daily journey through the universe. 🚀
We relive Artemis II (April 2026): the first crew around the Moon in more than 50 years, a record 406,771 km from Earth, the far side and a total solar eclipse, and a Mach 33 homecoming.

➡️ Tomorrow, Episode 40: Next stop, where we might find alien life.
Start from Episode 1 "Leaving Earth" on the channel.
Follow so you don't miss a stop. A new episode every day.

Images: NASA (public domain)
Narration: AI voice

#space #artemisii #astronomy #shorts #science

segments.text: Episode thirty-nine. Next stop... Artemis two.
In April twenty twenty-six, four astronauts flew around the Moon on Artemis two. The first crew to go there in more than fifty years.
segments.headline: April 2026

segments.text: They traveled four hundred six thousand seven hundred kilometers from Earth. The farthest any human has ever been.

visual.label: the farthest humans have ever traveled

segments.text: Behind the Moon, they saw parts of the far side no human eyes had ever seen, and even a total solar eclipse.
segments.headline: A view no one had seen

segments.text: They came home at about thirty-three times the speed of sound, and splashed down off San Diego.
Next, Artemis three aims to land astronauts on the Moon once again.
segments.headline: Next: landing on the Moon

segments.text: Tomorrow, our journey asks the biggest question of all. Next stop: where we might find alien life. Follow, so you don't miss episode forty.
